name: AktOn1 Plugin Hub
author: AktOn1
description: One bar icon and flyout for the AktOn1 plugins you have installed. Create several scratchpads (own key, own slide-in side, own frame, apps that start at login), set the fullscreen layer, and install the other AktOn1 plugins. None of them needs the Hub, and it bundles none. Connected: one flyout. Separated: one icon per plugin.
